**Description**
 Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.
   

  

 We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.
   

  

 At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.
   

  

 We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.
   

  

 We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.
   

  

 If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 RBS Tech team puts a high value on work\-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal \& Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE\-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You make appropriate trade\-offs, re\-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Business Unit:** 
 EPS Mobility
   

  

**Role:** 
 Algorithm Architect \- ADAS
   

  

 The Algorithm Architect – ADAS is responsible for defining, designing, and validating algorithms that enable advanced driver assistance and autonomous driving functions. * Architect algorithms for multi\-sensor object detection, classification, and tracking, leveraging both traditional signal processing and AI/ML methods.

* Optimize algorithms for embedded performance, latency, and memory efficiency while maintaining high accuracy.
* Collaborate with system architects, software engineers, and data scientists to ensure seamless integration and deployment.
* Conduct algorithm performance evaluations using simulation, SIL/HIL, and on\-vehicle validation.
* Contribute to functional safety (ISO 26262\) and SOTIF (ISO 21448\) compliance from an algorithmic perspective.

* Mentor and guide algorithm engineers in technical design, modeling, and validation best practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Robotics or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in ADAS / Autonomous Driving algorithm development or similar domains.
* Deep understanding of sensor processing, computer vision, sensor fusion, path planning, and vehicle control algorithms.
* Strong experience with C/C\+\+, Python, and MATLAB/Simulink for algorithm design and validation.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and embedded AI deployment (CNN \& latest technologies).
* Experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive environments.
* Solid understanding of vehicle dynamics, control theory, and state estimation techniques (Kalman Filters, Particle Filters, etc.).
* Experience with HIL/SIL validation, simulation tools (e.g. CarMaker) and data replay systems.
* Working knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262\) and SOTIF concepts.
* Strong grasp of vehicle communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet) and ECU architecture.
* Familiarity with AI\-based perception pipelines (CNNs, RNNs, transformer\-based architectures) for object detection and tracking.
* Knowledge of sensor calibration, time synchronization, and data fusion frameworks (ROS/ROS2, ADTF, RTMaps).
* Experience with GPU/SoC\-based acceleration (NVIDIA, Qualcomm, TI etc.).
* Exposure to cybersecurity and over\-the\-air (OTA) update strategies.
* Contributions to research papers or patents in the ADAS/autonomous driving field.
* Strong analytical and abstract thinking capabilities.
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Leadership and mentoring ability for algorithm development teams.
* Passion for innovation in intelligent mobility and autonomous systems.

 L\&T is a USD 30 billion Indian multinational engaged in EPC Projects, Hi\-Tech Manufacturing, and Services, operating across multiple geographies. A strong, customer–focussed approach and the constant quest for top\-class quality have enabled L\&T to attain and sustain leadership in its major lines of business for eight decades.

title: Software Engineering Architect (Agent)
description:
**Description**
 Trintech is the leader in AI Financial Close Management, helping finance and accounting teams transform the way they work by eliminating manual burdens, strengthening controls, and empowering strategic decision\-making.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Software Architect** 
 to own the technical architecture of the
 **Agent Stream** 
 — the agent orchestration engine, inter\-agent communication contracts, data layer design, and on\-prem to cloud migration path. This is a
 **hands\-on IC role, not an advisory one** 
 . You write design documents, build foundational components, review critical PRs, and set the engineering quality bar by example. You report to the Director of Engineering and are the senior technical IC in the stream, collaborating with the Engineering Manager on delivery and with Tech Leads across squads on implementation quality. The right person reasons from first principles in distributed systems and system design. Cloud\-native production experience required; Azure preferred.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Architecture Ownership**
* Own the Agent Stream architecture end\-to\-end — the orchestration engine, inter\-agent contracts (handoffs, shared context, escalation chains), data layer design, and on\-prem to cloud migration sequencing: what moves first, what requires refactoring, how to maintain continuity throughout.
* Define structured event emission standards for every agent — what must be emitted for platform\-level observability, audit, and metering. Own instrumentation standards that enable traceability and evaluation across the stream.
* Make and document foundational architecture decisions with clear rationale, trade\-off analysis, and long\-term implications. Proactively identify design debt, scalability bottlenecks, and failure cascade risks before they affect delivery.


**Hands\-On Technical Delivery**
* Commit to code — build foundational components, review critical PRs, lead high and low\-level design sessions, whiteboard architecture decisions, and challenge proposals with depth.
* Collaborate with the Platform Architect on decisions that span agent and platform layers: event contracts, authentication boundaries, and service integration patterns.
* Define and enforce engineering standards across the Agent Stream — API contract design, service observability, test coverage, and event emission. Provide technical direction to Agent Stream Tech Leads as the senior technical IC.


**Who You Are**
**Distributed Systems \& System Design — Primary Gate**
* 12\+ years in software engineering with primary depth in large\-scale distributed systems — failure modes, scalability trade\-offs, and design reasoning from first principles. Engineering reasoning is the gate, not tool familiarity. The ability to explain why a design was chosen, what failure modes it introduces, and what changes under different constraints is what is evaluated.
* Owns all Agent Stream architecture end\-to\-end: component boundaries, data contracts, and service\-level design at both high and low level.


**Cloud Native \& Infrastructure**
* Production experience on at least one public cloud — Azure preferred. Includes Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous release practices. Experience sequencing on\-prem to cloud migrations: what moves first, what requires refactoring, and how to maintain continuity.


**Security \& Identity**
* OAuth 2\.0 and IAM — production experience with authentication flows, token management, and identity propagation across services. Defence\-in\-depth awareness sufficient to design agents that do not introduce security gaps. Identifies risks and escalates to the Platform Architect.


**API, Event \& Data Design**
* API design and OpenAPI contracts — service\-level agent boundaries and inter\-service communication patterns. Event emission design for structured downstream platform consumption covering observability, audit, and metering.
* Multi\-tenant patterns: tenant isolation, scoped data access, and per\-tenant configuration at agent and service level. PostgreSQL at production scale: schema design, query optimisation, and data modelling for agent state and audit logs.


**Code Quality \& Standards**
* Defines what well\-structured, testable, and observable code looks like at the architectural level. Reviews critical code across the stream, identifies systemic quality issues, and sets the engineering bar through example.


**Awareness**
* Workflow orchestration — Temporal or equivalent event\-driven patterns, sufficient to design agents integrating correctly with the platform workflow layer. Observability: trace standards, structured logging, Langfuse. Security principles beyond OAuth sufficient to identify risks and escalate to the Platform Architect.


**Nice to Have**
* LangChain and LangGraph — agent orchestration frameworks for building and composing multi\-step agent graphs, tool use, and state management. Familiarity with AI\-native SDLC and Human\-led Agentic SDLC practices is a plus.
* Production experience in Python — enables deeper code review and hands\-on contribution to the agent codebase. Not a gate for this role; architecture depth matters more than the language.
* Azure certification demonstrating cloud platform depth. Financial close or R2R domain experience to accelerate ramp\-up on the business context the platform serves.


**What You’ll Learn \& Gain**
* End\-to\-end ownership of the technical architecture layer on a live enterprise financial platform used by global customers. Your architectural decisions are implemented at scale, with direct visibility into how they shape product behaviour and engineering outcomes.
* Deep hands\-on experience in distributed systems design, cloud\-native engineering, and event\-driven architecture in a production context where scalability, auditability, and reliability all matter simultaneously and cannot be traded off lightly.
* Exposure to building AI agent infrastructure in a high\-compliance, SOX\-governed environment — learning to balance system performance with explainability, traceability, and enterprise audit requirements in a production AI product.
* Close collaboration with engineering managers, tech leads, and a platform architect in a fast\-moving, squad\-based delivery model. Your architectural choices are implemented and validated rapidly, with tight feedback loops between design decisions and production outcomes.


 If you are an engineer who reasons from first principles, has shipped production distributed systems, and is ready to own the architectural foundation of an enterprise AI platform — we encourage you to apply.
   

  

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

 The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer\-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud\-native applications, and large\-scale data infrastructure.  Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. **About The Role**
 As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre\-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia\-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer\-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C\-suite executives, engineering \& IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
 **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** 
 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Director of Software Engineering
 



  





 Medical Enterprise \| Dental Healthcare \| Greater Bengaluru Area \| Hybrid
 



  





 About the Client
 



 Our client is a high\-growth medical enterprise serving major US clients across the dental and broader
 



 healthcare ecosystem. The company operates a vertically integrated, subscription\-led procurement and
 



 supply\-chain platform spanning dental, veterinary, lab, and adjacent medical categories. The business is
 



 revenue positive and is scaling into a broader healthcare enterprise platform.
 



 The Role
 



 This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role for a Founding Engineer / VP Engineering\-type profile.
 



 You will lead a 10–15 member engineering team while owning system design, software architecture,
 



 delivery execution, and people leadership. Architecture and execution are the primary evaluation areas;
 



 this is not a management\-only role.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 ● Lead a 10–15 member engineering team, with responsibility for hiring, coaching, performance, team
 



 development, and delivery.
 



 ● Own system design and software architecture for scalable, data\-heavy, distributed and cloud\-native
 



 platforms; lead architecture reviews and key technical decisions.
 



 ● Stay hands\-on enough to challenge designs, review critical technical decisions, guide implementation,
 



 and unblock engineering teams while driving predictable execution.
 



 ● Scale the engineering platform and organization sustainably—improving reliability, observability, code
 



 quality, testing, CI/CD, release processes, and technical debt.
 



 ● Drive AI transformation across the SDLC using Applied AI for code generation, testing, developer
 



 productivity, workflow automation, evaluation, and engineering\-process improvement.
 



 ● Evaluate new technologies and establish pragmatic engineering standards, development
 



 methodologies, and best practices as the company scales.
 



 ● Partner closely with Product, Data, and Operations to evolve the business from a scale\-up into a
 



 broader medical/dental enterprise ecosystem.
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 ● 12–15\+ years of software engineering experience preferred; 10\+ years is the bare minimum for
 



 exceptional candidates with strong architecture and leadership depth.
 



 ● Strong product\-company background, ideally in data\-heavy Series A, B, or C startups or bootstrapped
 



 scale\-ups; Founding Engineer, early engineering leader, or VP Engineering\-type experience is highly
 



 relevant.
 



 ● Deep expertise in SYSTEM DESIGN and SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE, combined with people
 



 management and hands\-on technical leadership—not a management\-only profile.
 



 ● Proven experience scaling an engineering team from single digits to at least 10–15 people;
 



 experience building or leading a 30\+ person engineering organization is strongly preferred.
 



 ● Track record of scaling products through significant revenue growth; ideally part of a profitable $10M
 



 → $100M ARR journey with sustainable engineering practices.
 



  





 ● Strong backend/architecture experience with Python, Node.js, and/or Go, plus Kafka, RabbitMQ,
 



 Terraform, and modern cloud\-Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, event\-driven architecture,
 



 data design, service boundaries, scalability, reliability, and observability.
 



 ● Practical Applied AI experience, especially AI\-led SDLC transformation across code generation,
 



 testing, automation, developer workflows, evaluation/observability, and production reliability. Model
 



 fine\-tuning is a plus.
 



 ● Strong delivery execution, stakeholder management, agile development practices, communication,
 



 and ability to build high\-performing teams in fast\-growth environments.
 



 ● Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or
 



 equivalent practical experience.
 



 Nice to Have
 



 ● Domain exposure to dental, healthcare, medical supply chain, procurement, veterinary, lab platforms,
 



 marketplaces, or other data\-heavy enterprise products.
 



 ● Experience serving major US customers and scaling a lean startup/scale\-up into a mature enterprise
 



 platform ecosystem.

title: Guidewire Technical Architect – ClaimCenter / Jutro
description:
**Summary**
 Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P\&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI\-enabled delivery. We work as one global team, combining deep product expertise, implementation excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement to help customers realize value faster. Our environment is collaborative, customer\-obsessed, and innovation\-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform.
   

  

 As a Guidewire Architect focused on ClaimCenter / Jutro, you will define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for complex Guidewire implementations, modernization programs, and digital transformation initiatives across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will provide architectural leadership for ClaimCenter implementations, claims transformation programs, and digital experience solutions built using Jutro, ensuring scalable, secure, and high\-performing solutions that accelerate customer value.
   

  

 This role is ideal for a hands\-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers’ path to value while contributing to Professional Services’ mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you’ll do**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro\-based digital solutions across on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring alignment with customer enterprise architecture and Guidewire best practices.
* Lead solution design and implementation, including ClaimCenter configuration and customization (Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, integrations, and plugins) and/or Jutro digital experience architecture, UI design, and portal development, delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
* Architect and oversee complex integrations between Guidewire applications and enterprise systems such as policy administration, billing, CRM, document management, data platforms, and third\-party services using APIs, web services, messaging, and event\-driven patterns.
* Provide technical leadership to cross\-functional delivery teams through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering governance, driving quality, reusability, automation, and best\-in\-class delivery practices.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, and customer teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions that address performance, availability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Champion cloud adoption, AI\-enabled delivery, and automation initiatives to accelerate implementation timelines, improve productivity, and establish repeatable delivery patterns across programs.
* Contribute to organizational assets including accelerators, reference architectures, technical standards, and thought leadership while promoting knowledge sharing across Guidewire, customer, and partner teams globally.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Required**
**What you’ll bring**
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, automation, and data\-driven insights to improve delivery efficiency, solution quality, and customer outcomes.
* 10–18 years of software engineering and architecture experience, including significant hands\-on expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter and/or Jutro, with experience leading at least two large\-scale implementation, modernization, or cloud transformation programs.
* Deep expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter configuration and architecture, including Gosu, data model extensions, rules, workflows, activities, integrations, plugins, and Guidewire development best practices; or strong expertise in Jutro architecture and development, including digital portals, UI frameworks, component design, and customer\-facing insurance applications.
* Guidewire ClaimCenter ACE Certification, Jutro certification, or equivalent Guidewire implementation credentials preferred.
* Proven experience designing and delivering complex integrations using REST APIs, web services, messaging frameworks, and event\-driven architectures across Guidewire and enterprise ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design, cloud\-native architecture, performance optimization, security best practices, scalability, resiliency, and non\-functional requirements for mission\-critical applications.
* Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences in Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, customers, and time zones.


**Preferred**
* Experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP), including cloud\-native implementation patterns, observability, DevOps, and CI/CD practices.
* Proven success leading ClaimCenter Cloud, Jutro digital transformation, or Guidewire modernization programs leveraging automation and AI\-enabled delivery approaches.
* Familiarity with other Guidewire products such as PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Data Platform, and Analytics.
* Experience with modern microservices, API\-first architectures, event\-driven systems, and digital experience platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


**Your Impact**
 We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services’ priorities around AI\-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery.
   

  

 You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire’s cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world’s P\&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire’s ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally.
   

  

**About Guidewire**
 Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
   

  

 As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.

title: Senior Principal Engineer
description:
TechGrove is the
 **Centre of Excellence** 
 for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long\-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer\-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 



**Senior Principal Engineer** 




*Technical Lead / Architect, TechGrove AI Engineering Pod* 




 You are the kind of engineer other engineers want to build with. You have spent your career going deep on production systems, and you have reached the point where your judgment shapes architectures, raises teams, and makes hard problems look simple. This is the most senior technical seat in the pod, and it is unapologetically hands\-on.
 



 As Technical Lead and Architect, you own the architecture for an OpCo’s modernized applications and set the engineering bar the whole pod builds to. You operate as a player/coach: designing complex systems, writing meaningful code, and running rigorous reviews of work produced by both engineers and AI agents. You treat agentic development as a first\-class part of the architecture, not a novelty, and you define how the pod gets the most out of it without ever compromising quality or security.
 



 If you want your decisions to matter, your code to ship, and your standards to lift an entire team, this is built for you.
 


**About the Pod** 

 A TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self\-contained, AI\-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
 



 A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high\-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India\-based TechGrove.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* **Own the architecture:** 
 Define and own the end\-to\-end software architecture for the pod’s applications, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and cloud\-native across AWS and Azure.
* **Own the frontend architecture:** 
 Set the frontend architecture: state management, a scalable library of reusable components, design\-system integration, and the patterns, standards, and performance budgets the pod builds against.
* **Lead the technical direction:** 
 Serve as the highest technical authority and escalation point in the pod. Set design patterns and standards, and make confident architectural decisions amid ambiguity.
* **Stay hands\-on:** 
 Operate as a player/coach. Make significant code contributions, lead complex designs, and deliver thorough code reviews of work from both engineers and AI agents.
* **Lead AI\-native development:** 
 Define how the pod uses agentic tooling such as Claude Code across the SDLC, establishing patterns for AI\-assisted design, implementation, testing, and review that maximize velocity while protecting quality and security.
* **Set the quality bar:** 
 Define and enforce engineering excellence: clean code, Domain\-Driven Design, modern design patterns, Twelve\-Factor principles, meaningful test coverage, and application security.
* **Build secure and reliable systems:** 
 Embed secure\-by\-design principles and cloud\-native observability so applications run fast, stay available, and stay safe in production.
* **Mentor and raise the team:** 
 Coach senior engineers, grow the technical capability of the team (human and agentic), and foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* **Partner with the OpCo:** 
 Work with the OpCo’s technical leadership and existing teams to align architecture with their landscape, integrate with existing systems, and transfer knowledge.


**What You Bring** 
* **Experience:** 
 10\+ years in software engineering, with significant time in Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Architect roles leading the architecture of complex, production systems.
* **Production experience on BOTH AWS and Azure (required):** 
 You have personally designed, built, and run production software on both AWS and Azure. This dual\-cloud depth is essential: you are the technical authority who sets cloud architecture regardless of which target cloud an OpCo runs on. Hands\-on depth includes containers (Docker/Kubernetes), serverless (Lambda and Azure Functions), and Infrastructure\-as\-Code with Terraform.
* **Architectural depth:** 
 Deep command of modern architectural patterns (microservices, event\-driven, distributed systems), DDD, and design patterns, with a record of turning business objectives into technical solutions at enterprise or B2B scale.
* **Hands\-on technical depth:** 
 Current, real coding ability. A player/coach who contributes code, leads design, and delivers thorough reviews, including of AI\-generated work.
* **AI\-native engineering:** 
 Demonstrated fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling (Claude Code or similar) and a clear, practiced approach to architecting and delivering software in an AI\-native team.
* **Modern tech stacks:** 
 Hands\-on production experience with at least two of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, and Java.
* **Frontend architecture:** 
 Deep expertise in modern frontend architecture with React.js and Next.js: state management, scalable and reusable component design, design\-system strategy, and frontend performance at scale.
* **DevSecOps:** 
 Strong command of CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and modern DevSecOps practices.
* **Communication and leadership:** 
 You align technical and business stakeholders, lead under competing priorities, and bring calm and clarity to fast\-moving teams.


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience building and operating multi\-tenant SaaS at scale.
* A track record leading application modernization or re\-platforming of large enterprise or B2B applications.
* GenAI architecture experience: RAG and GraphRAG, LLM orchestration, multi\-agent frameworks, MCP servers and tools, context engineering, and vector databases.
* Experience leading embedded or client\-facing engineering teams.
* Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS and Azure.


**What Success Looks Like** 
* **First 90 days:** 
 You understand the OpCo’s landscape, have set the architectural direction and engineering standards, and the pod is shipping against them with a clean, AI\-native workflow.
* **First 6 months:** 
 The architecture is proven in production, quality and delivery metrics are trending up, and the team’s technical capability, human and agentic, has visibly grown under your leadership.


**Why TechGrove, Why Banyan** 
* **Permanent home, long\-term thinking:** 
 Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
* **Real ownership:** 
 You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
* **AI\-native by default:** 
 You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
* **Variety with stability:** 
 Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
* **Growth and excellence:** 
 A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.


**Should You Apply?** 

 We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.
 



 We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI\-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.
 







***Beware of Recruitment Scams***




 We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 
 



**Protect yourself by following these steps:** 



* Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an
 **@banyansoftware.com** 
 email address.
* Remember, employers will
 **never** 
 request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
* If you receive a suspicious message,
 **do not respond** 
 — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.



 Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

title: Senior CAD Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000\+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event\-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins\-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch\-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large\-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
* Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.
* Leading the modernization of legacy services — evaluating existing Perl and Python backends, proposing migration strategies, and driving execution with the team.
* Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare\-metal Linux hosts.
* Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
* Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality\-of\-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.
* Helping invent next\-generation semiconductor design methodology.
* Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products — a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer.


**What We Want To See**
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems.
* Strong software architecture and design skills — experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies.
* Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale.
* Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support.
* Comfort owning and debugging Linux\-based production services.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar).
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding.
* Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores.
* Exposure to Static Timing Analysis or VLSI physical design.


 NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce — we want to hear from you.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Distributed Systems
description:
logcat.ai is the AI engineering layer for the operating\-system stack. We build agentic systems for Linux and Android devices: we ingest the diagnostic artifacts a device emits (bugreports, logcat, dmesg, modem traces, ramdumps, perfetto, pcap, CAN) and help device makers diagnose, remediate, test, and author features across their OS stack, grounded in their own BSP. A VC\-backed startup with a small, senior team — you work directly with the founders.
 



  





 We recently raised a $2\.55M pre\-seed. The product is scaling and the customer list is growing. The team is still small, so you'll own what you build.
 



  





 Own the core platform end to end: ingestion and processing of very large system\-log artifacts, the runtime under our AI investigation agents, and the infrastructure that keeps it all reliable for customers. This is a founding seat — architecture, tech selection, CI/CD, and reliability are your calls, and you'll have a real vote in what we build and who we hire next.
 



  





 We're not hiring for a traditional lane. We want someone who builds the automation, agentic workflows, and self\-scaling systems that let a small team ship like a large one.
 



  





**A note on location** 




 This role is on\-site in Bengaluru. We've kept it that way on purpose: the platform work moves fastest with people in a room together, and this is the seat where that matters most. You must be eligible to work in India.
 



  





**The Bar** 




 A quick, honest gut\-check before you spend time on an application. If most of this sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to talk.
 



  




* 5\+ years building backend or distributed systems at product companies. You've personally owned a system under real load and can talk concretely about its failure modes.
* Full\-stack capable: you'll ship the API, the pipeline, the infra, and sometimes the UI.
* AI\-native: you build harnesses and evals, not just accept autocomplete.
* Startup DNA: you've worked at an early or high\-growth startup, or genuinely want to now. Ownership over lanes, speed over ceremony, many hats.
* Proficient in day\-to\-day work with CLI\-based AI coding tools like Claude Code (or an equivalent). It's how the team operates, not a nice\-to\-have.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build ingestion and processing for very large system\-log artifacts, and the runtime our AI investigation agents run on.
* Own the infrastructure that keeps the platform reliable for customers: architecture, tech selection, CI/CD.
* Build the automation and agentic workflows that let a small team ship like a large one.



  





**Bonus** 



* Observability, logging, or tracing systems.
* eBPF, Perfetto, ftrace.
* OS internals.
* Public OSS track record.



  





**What we offer you** 



* A front seat as we scale. Customer calls, the roadmap, the pipeline, how the company is actually doing.
* Top\-of\-market salary and founding equity. You'll own a piece of what you build.
* The AI tools you need. We use AI across writing code, reviewing it, research, ops, and internal tooling. If something would help you work better, we'll get it.
* Early ownership, and full visibility. We move fast, and you'll help decide where.
* Comprehensive medical insurance for you and your family.
* Start\-up perks and flexible time off, the kind people actually take.
* A small team that's easy to work with. People here like solving hard problems and helping each other out.



  





**What to expect after you apply** 



* Screening call with Head of People \& Business Operations
* Technical conversation with Co\-founder/ Head of Engineering
* Technical exercise with Co\-founder/ Head of Engineering
* Final conversation with CEO
* References, then offer



  





 In your application, tell us what you'd own here, and the hardest thing you've shipped, a link to something you've built beats a resume.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer - Golang + Control Plane
description:

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

 We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer (C and Go) to join our Engineering team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, (3 days a week in office), reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering.You will work on the control plane for the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), ZDX products, which has redefined how security services are delivered in the cloud.

description:
Job Title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
 


  

  


 Division: Assessment \& Qualifications Delivery
 


  

  


 Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)
 


  

  


**Role Summary** 



  

  


 As a Solution Architect (E30\), you will design and deliver new services on Microsoft Azure aligned with Pearson’s enterprise standards. Your remit includes the development of secure, scalable solution architectures, while ensuring integration across legacy on\-premise and AWS components where needed. You will collaborate with product owners, business analysts, delivery teams (including technical architects and developers) and external partners to convert business requirements into effective technical solutions. This includes evaluating solution options, estimating costs and ensuring that designs meet both functional and non\-functional requirements (e.g. security, performance, availability, scalability). Clear communication and stakeholder engagement are essential in this role.
 


  

  


**Key Responsibilities** 



  

  
* Solution Architecture Design: Lead the design of end\-to\-end solutions on Azure (and advise on on\-premise or AWS where needed), selecting optimal services and patterns to meet both functional and non\-functional requirements. Produce architecture blueprints, dataflows and interface specifications.
  

  
* Solution Option Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Work with business analysts and product owners to evaluate multiple solution options, ensuring the trade\-offs are understood. Provide cost and effort estimations (including infrastructure, licensing and operational considerations), and help recommend solutions that balance performance, scalability and total cost of ownership.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Governance: Serve as design authority throughout delivery. Provide guidance, mentoring and quality assurance to delivery teams and third\-party partners. Develop and refine architectural standards where gaps exist to ensure consistent best practices.
  

  
* Support Delivery Teams: Collaborate closely with delivery teams—including technical architects, developers, testers and DevOps engineers—to interpret and implement architecture designs correctly. Assist with troubleshooting technical issues, and ensure that Technical Architects and developers share a common understanding of architecture decisions and design patterns.
  

  
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with product owners, business analysts, subject matter experts and external partners to refine requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment and shared understanding.
  

  
* Vendor Oversight: Work with third\-party delivery teams, reviewing their architectures, holding them accountable to Pearson’s standards and supporting them in meeting quality targets.
  

  
* Documentation \& Planning: Produce system diagrams, interface specifications and implementation roadmaps. Ensure design decisions are thoroughly documented and communicated.
  

  
* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement: Monitor industry trends and evaluate new technologies (e.g. infrastructure automation, AI, data platforms) for relevance to Pearson. Propose enhancements that support robust, modern and cost\-effective solutions.
  

  
* Compliance \& Security: Ensure all solutions comply with Pearson’s security and data privacy standards. Participate in design reviews and governance forums to ensure compliance with enterprise architecture policies.
  

  
* Lifecycle Support: Support implementation teams from development through deployment, addressing technical issues and ensuring solutions deliver the intended business value.
  


  


**Essential Experience \& Skills** 



  

  
* Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: Proven track record of designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions, with a strong emphasis on Azure cloud services and cloud\-native principles.
  

  
* Architecture \& Design Expertise: Ability to produce architecture blueprints, dataflows, integration diagrams and detailed specifications.
  

  
* Cloud Proficiency: Deep understanding of Azure compute, storage, networking, security and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g. ARM, Terraform). Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices.
  

  
* Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Experience overseeing design implementation, defining architectural standards and providing technical guidance to teams and vendors.
  

  
* Solution Analysis \& Cost Estimation: Ability to evaluate solution options and provide well\-reasoned recommendations based on technical fit, effort and cost.
  

  
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication and interpersonal skills; able to articulate architecture rationale to technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster alignment.
  

  
* Problem Solving \& Adaptability: Proven analytical skills and adaptability; comfortable working in dynamic environments and adjusting solutions as requirements evolve.
  

  
* Business Insight: Ability to balance technology decisions with business outcomes to ensure solutions deliver value.
  

  
* Education \& Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; Master’s degree and/or relevant certifications (e.g. BCS Intermediate Certificate in Enterprise Architecture, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly regarded.
  


  


**Desirable Skills** 



  

  
* Knowledge of relational databases, data modelling and data analytics solutions.
  

  
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines and containerisation (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes).
  

  
* Experience with Agile methodologies, TDD and other modern development practices.
  

  
* Programming/scripting for automation (PowerShell, Python).
  

  
* Good understanding of AWS PaaS services (such as RDS/SQL, SNS, Aurora) to support integrated or legacy components.
  

  
* Understanding of business continuity and disaster recovery planning.
  

  
* Awareness of AI/ML and emerging technologies and their impact on architecture.
  


  


**Job Location and Hours** 



  

  


 The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.

description:
**About The Team**
 Walmart's Global Tech Platforms team, also known as GTP, helps thousands of developers save time and code better, so that millions of Walmart associates can help hundreds of millions of customers to save money and live better.
   

  

 We sustain millions of transactions per second, process petabytes of data, and enable tens of thousands of production deployments per day. We simplify the complexities of scale and unify the software development for all aspects of business, digital and physical.
   

  

 We are developer’s developers. We provide and foster the cloud native culture to our organization. Our team has the whole gamut of platforms, services, libraries, tools and frameworks on some of the cutting\-edge technologies to solve hard, complex and high scale business problems. The Infrastructure as a Service team provides private and public cloud infrastructure \- compute (VMs, CPUs, GPUs and Bare metals), storage (CEPH), SDN and container platform. The Software Development Environment – SDE team – provides world class CI/CD pipelines, workflow automation, repositories and OneOps deployment tool providing ultimate DevOps power to developers for continuous delivery. The application foundation team provides multi\-tenant managed services for authz, messaging (JMS, Kafka), caching, externalized gateways, cloud configuration, massive centralized log search farm, telemetry, Cassandra/Oracle/MySql/MS\-QL/Cloud RDBMS for the developer community of Walmart. All of the developer\-productivity tools provided by GTP are continuously enhanced through recent advancements in GenAI. These solutions are frequently revamped to capitalize on the latest progress in both AI and GenAI, ensuring that teams always benefit from the most modern capabilities.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Our ideal candidate is an energetic, self\-motivated individual focused on solving customer problems. He/she is a responsive team player who can proactively contribute for building technical strategies for applications and systems by promoting an understanding of the technology and business roadmap. When you add the numbers, you will realize that this role will probably help influence the largest pool of customers anywhere in the world. If that gives you goose bumps \- then you are the kind of candidate, we want.
   

  

 You will be responsible for development of developer facing applications that are used to boost the developer productivity and experience of Walmart developers.
   

  

 Lead a team of top\-notch engineers to successfully build and deploy cutting edge platforms. Lead and direct large\-scale, complex, cross\-functional projects by reviewing project requirements; translating requirements into technical solutions; directing and reviewing
   

  

 Design artifacts (for example, proof of concepts, prototypes); write and develop code; oversee software design; review unit test cases; communicate status and issues to team members and stakeholders; direct project team and cross functional teams; enhance design to prevent recurrences of defects; ensure on\-time delivery and hand\-offs; interact with project manager to provide input on project plan; and provide leadership to the project team.
   

  

 You will work in our own internal open stack cloud, Azure, GCP, using several technologies including but not limited to JAVA, Spring, Kafka, Cosmos DB, REST APIs, GraphQL, Python, data solutions etc.
   

  

 Focus on goal completion and support teams to overcome the challenges in implementation
   

  

 Work with senior leadership to chart out the roadmap of the products
   

  

 Improve, optimize and identify opportunities for efficient software development processes
   

  

 Work very closely with different product and business stakeholders at various locations in US and India to drive the execution of multiple business plans and technologies
   

  

 Exhibit strong leadership and communication skills to collaborate with product, engineering and management teams across different geographic locations
   

  

 Improve, optimize and identify opportunities for efficient software development processes
   

  

 Hire, Develop and Retain a strong team of software engineers.
   

  

 Interact with Walmart engineering teams across geographies to leverage expertise and contribute to the tech community
   

  

 Promote and support company policies, procedures, mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Deep expertise in architecture and design patterns, cloud\-native microservices, and building resilient, reliable, high\-quality software.
   

  

 Strong technical mindset with hands\-on product development experience and the ability to deep\-dive into complex technical issues.
   

  

 Exposure to program management practices, including dependency management and cross\-team development tracking.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with developer platforms is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Proven ability to build, lead, and mentor high\-performing engineering teams.
   

  

 Thought leadership and the ethos of a people\-first leader.
   

  

 Demonstrated success working effectively with distributed, global teams in a collaborative and productive manner.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and a consistent track record of delivering outcomes in complex, fast\-paced environments.
   

  

 Strong sense of ownership with a focus on quality, responsiveness, efficiency, and continuous innovation.
   

  

 Ability to guide teams through technical challenges and drive clarity during execution.
   

  

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across teams, functions, and geographies.
   

  

 Ability to influence, align, and collaborate with diverse partners and stakeholders.
   

  

 Passion for quick learning and adapting in a dynamic global environment.
   

  

 An Engineering Degree \- B.E/B.Tech/MS in any stream – Computer Science preferred.
   

  

 14\+ years of relevant experience, Minimum of 5 years of experience with agile principles and practices. Experience in leading Scrum teams.
   

  

 Hands on experience in building scalable cloud native software platforms/applications
   

  

 Very strong understanding and experience in the area of software development lifecycle.
   

  

 Strong Java/J2EE, React skill ( good to have)
   

  

 Strong understanding of architecture, database, messaging , (Kafka services)
   

  

 SQL/Cosmos/Azure database proficiency
   

  

 Experience in leading and delivering full\-stack developer platform applications would be desirable
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 Work
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our \[Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people
   

  

 Minimum Qualifications...Outlined below are the required minimum qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no minimum qualifications.
   

  

 Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 5 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.
   

  

 Option 2: 7 years’ experience in software engineering or related area. 2 years’ supervisory experience.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications...Outlined below are the optional preferred qualifications for this position. If none are listed, there are no preferred qualifications.
   

  

 Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years' experience in software engineering or related area., We value candidates with a background in creating inclusive digital experiences, demonstrating knowledge in implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2\.2 AA standards, assistive technologies, and integrating digital accessibility seamlessly. The ideal candidate would have knowledge of accessibility best practices and join us as we continue to create accessible products and services following Walmart’s accessibility standards and guidelines for supporting an inclusive culture.
   

  

 Primary Location...Building 10 (sez), Cessna Business Park, Kadubeesanahalli Village, Varthur Hobli , India

title: Senior Technical Consultant_ServiceNow ITAM,HAM,SAM Expertise
description:
Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Hyderabad, Bangalore
   

  

 Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
   

  

 Req Id: 11456
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 8/31/26
   

  

 At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world\-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
   

  

 With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co\-create solutions that drive enterprise\-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
   

  

 ServiceNow ITAM,HAM,SAM ExpertiseTechnical Design \& DeliveryCustomer \& Team Leadership
   

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Lead design: Translate requirements into solution design documents, user stories, and build specifications for HAM/SAM; own and defend design decisions in front of customer architects.
* Workshops: Support and co\-facilitate requirement and design workshops alongside the onsite counterpart; independently run technical deep\-dive sessions where required.
* Lead delivery: Drive the build across sprints — configuration, scripting, flows, integrations, and unit/system testing; manage update set / application repository migration and release hygiene.
* Customer engagement: Lead design walkthroughs, sprint playbacks, defect triage, and technical status discussions with customer stakeholders; provide estimates, flag risks early, and manage dependencies.
* HAM scope: Full asset lifecycle (request → receive → deploy → maintain → retire/dispose), stockroom and inventory management, transfer orders, procurement integration, asset–CI reconciliation, refresh and audit processes, Asset Workspace and mobile capabilities.
* SAM scope: Software discovery and normalization, entitlement/license import, reconciliation and compliance positions, publisher packs (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe), software model management, and remediation workflows.
* Build on the existing footprint: Leverage the customer's live CMDB/ITOM investment — Discovery data quality, CSDM alignment, Identification \& Reconciliation (IRE), and integration with endpoint/discovery sources (e.g., SCCM/MECM, Intune, JAMF) — without degrading existing data quality.
* Team leadership: Set development standards, review the work of supporting developers, and coordinate across onsite/offshore team members.REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS
* 8\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow platform experience, with 3\+ years focused on ITAM (HAM/SAM). Minimum two full\-cycle HAM and/or SAM Pro implementations delivered end\-to\-end (design through hypercare). Candidates must be able to walk through these engagements in detail — scope, architecture, key design decisions, integration landscape, and lessons learned.
* Strong platform architecture and development depth: scoped applications, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP integrations, ACL/security model, performance considerations, and instance hygiene.
* CMDB/ITOM working knowledge: CSDM, Discovery data flows, and reconciliation — able to design HAM/SAM on top of a mature, live CMDB.
* Proven ability to lead independently: facilitate workshops, defend design positions, and manage customer technical stakeholders with minimal supervision.
* Strong verbal and written English, comfortable presenting to customer architects and program leadership.


 CERTIFICATIONS
   

  

* Required: ServiceNow CSA; CIS–HAM and CIS–SAM (at least one; both strongly preferred).
* Preferred: CAD (Certified Application Developer), CIS–Discovery or CIS–ITSM; certifications current on recent platform releases.


 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

* Experience delivering ITAM in financial services or public sector environments (audit/regulatory\-driven SAM, vendor audits, true\-ups).
* Exposure to SaaS License Management / license optimization initiatives.
* Familiarity with procurement/ERP integration patterns for asset intake.
* App Engine / custom scoped application delivery experience.


 CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will undergo a scenario\-based technical assessment and should expect to:
   

  

* Present a prior HAM/SAM implementation — architecture, design decisions, integration landscape, and outcomes.
* Respond to live design scenarios — e.g., asset–CI reconciliation conflicts, license position discrepancies, normalization gaps.
* Demonstrate hands\-on familiarity with SAM Pro reconciliation and HAM lifecycle configuration in a guided technical discussion.


 Only candidates who can independently articulate and defend design decisions at this stage will be progressed.
   

  

 Relocation Supported:
   

  

**Visa Sponsorship Approved**
 At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Technologieingenieur (m/w/d)
description:

 Diese Rolle umfasst das Design und die Implementierung einer SUSE\-basierten Virtualisierungsplattform mit KVM als Hypervisor für SAP\- und Nicht\-SAP\-Workloads. Diese Position erfordert
 **6\+ Jahre Erfahrung**

**Aufgaben**

title: AI Solution Architect / AI Solutions Lead – Agentic AI
description:

 **10 years of overall experience** 
 and a strong
 **6\+ year foundation in Machine Learning / AI** 
 .
