title: Solution Architect- Infrastructure, cloud & security
description:
Role Overview:
 



  





 We are looking for a Solution Architect with strong Infrastructure and Azure expertise who can design secure, resilient and supportable solutions in a large, complex organisation.
 



  





 The essential focus of this role is infrastructure, cloud and networking architecture across on\-premises, Azure and hybrid environments. The successful candidate will be technically credible in Azure and infrastructure design, with sufficient networking depth to shape connectivity decisions and work effectively with network engineering and security specialists. They will also be able to think beyond a single technology silo and understand the wider impact of their decisions across security, identity, integration, operations and business outcomes.
 



  





 Our technology estate includes SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Genesys and Azure\-based platforms. Direct experience across all of these platforms is not required, but the successful candidate should be comfortable working with architects and specialists across these domains.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong cloud and infrastructure knowledge with practical networking architecture experience, company\-wide solution thinking, sound judgement and curiosity about how different technology domains interact.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead infrastructure and cloud architecture activities across a diverse technology landscape.
* Design secure, resilient and supportable solutions aligned to enterprise standards.
* Contribute to Azure strategy, cloud adoption and platform evolution.
* Define and assure networking and connectivity architectures across on\-premises, Azure and hybrid environments, working with network engineering and security specialists where detailed engineering expertise is required.
* Work closely with architects across SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Data and Integration domains.
* Support enterprise identity, authentication and access management strategies.
* Contribute to security architecture discussions and ensure security is embedded into solution designs.
* Support architecture governance, roadmap development and domain stewardship activities where relevant.
* Help define infrastructure standards, patterns and architectural guardrails.
* Support enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives and cloud migration programmes.
* Consider operational supportability, resilience, disaster recovery and lifecycle management in solution designs.



  





**Essential Skills \& Experience:** 




  




* Strong Infrastructure Architecture experience.
* Strong Azure architecture experience.
* Experience designing solutions for large, complex organisations.
* Strong practical knowledge of on\-premises, cloud and hybrid networking architecture, including network segmentation, routing, DNS, firewalls, load balancing, private connectivity, resilience and secure cloud access patterns. Deep specialist expertise across every networking technology is not expected, but candidates must be able to make sound architectural decisions and work effectively with network engineering and security specialists.
* Experience working with identity and access management concepts.
* Ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Experience balancing technical, security, operational and business requirements.
* Strong communication and influencing skills.



  





**Highly Desirable** 




  





 The following areas are highly desirable rather than mandatory. We would not expect candidates to demonstrate deep expertise across all of them, but experience in some areas, combined with the curiosity and judgement to work effectively with specialists in the others, would be a strong advantage.
 


* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Understanding of Zero Trust principles.
* Experience with Conditional Access, Privileged Access and identity governance.
* Experience supporting enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow or Salesforce.
* Experience with security architecture and risk\-based design decisions.
* Understanding of integration and data architecture principles.
* Experience with cloud landing zones and enterprise governance models.
* Experience contributing to technology roadmaps and standards.



  





 The Type of Architect We Are Looking For
 



  





 We are seeking a strong Infrastructure and Azure architect who can think beyond a single technology silo.
 



  





 The successful candidate will understand that infrastructure decisions can impact applications, data, security, integration, operations and business outcomes. They will be comfortable working across architectural boundaries, collaborating with other domain specialists and helping shape solutions that are coherent across multiple technologies.
 



  





 Whilst Azure and Infrastructure will be their primary area of expertise, they will have a genuine interest in broader company\-wide technology considerations and an appreciation of how cloud, identity, security, integration and business platforms work together.
 



  





 Why This Role Is Different
 



  





 Many infrastructure architecture roles focus primarily on hosting, networking and cloud technologies.
 



 In this role, we are looking for someone who can combine deep Azure and infrastructure expertise with broader company\-wide solution thinking. The successful candidate will work alongside architects responsible for SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Data and Integration and will play a key role in shaping secure, resilient and supportable end\-to\-end solutions.

title: Salesforce Technical Architect, Consumer goods (REX or TPM or CG Cloud exp mandatory)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Technical Architect will be responsible for optimally solutioning the enterprise application E2E, designing and building the Salesforce Industry\-specific Retail \& Consumer Goods industry solutions.
   

  

 As a Technical Architect, you will become a deep product expert with Retail Execution or Trade promotion management applications, and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

Principal Engineer Target Marketplace Technology

 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here. As a Principal Engineer in Target Marketplace Technology, you set the strategy for software development and infrastructure engineering at Target. You set the direction for how software and infrastructure engineering efforts will be designed, developed, and operationalized across multiple portfolios and drive adoption. You lead and approve software and infrastructure engineering efforts to meet functional and non\-functional requirements. You are a thought leader and mentor for internal and external technical talent and actively contribute to the external technical community.
   

  

 Target Marketplace is an important growth area with an ambition to significantly scale the business in the coming years, and Marketplace Technology serves as a critical interface between Target and our sellers and channel partners. In this highly visible role, you will lead foundational architecture work that enables that growth, including reimagining Marketplace workflows and integration patterns across core Target enterprise systems for the needs of a scaled third\-party seller ecosystem.

* Understand Target's business and technical environments and provide the technical leadership in resolving complex business challenges via current technical solutions by assessing viability/applicability/cost implication through prototypes and POCs.

* Lead designing and building platform APIs and services with deep focus on non\-functional requirements including scalability, availability, performance, resilience, security, and operability, while being a strong advocate of agile and DevOps practices across engineers.
* Apply AI thoughtfully to accelerate engineering outcomes and help establish AI\-native approaches where they create meaningful business and technical advantage.
* Collaborate with technical staff, product partners, and Enterprise Architecture teams in setting technical direction across platforms and drive technology lifecycle management and communication of standards/decisions to the engineering team.
* Work with engineering leaders to build a high performing engineering team and provide technical leadership, coaching, motivation and participate in the selection of technical talent.


*Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.*

* API design and micro\-services architecture, such as to create interconnected services
* Experience with Cloud\-based data platforms, such as Snowflake
* Exposure to Data Lake or Lakehouse solutions
* Advanced SQL and database skills, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Strong architecture and design background, with knowledge of microservices, API design, secure coding, and distributed systems patterns
* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI, machine learning, and LLM\-based solutions, including practical use of AI APIs, prompt\-driven workflows, intelligent automation, or AI\-enabled application features
* Knowledge of the financial industry and compliance or risk functions


**Interpersonal Skills**
* Strong problem\-solving, critical thinking, and decision\-making skills in complex technical environments.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative working style with experience driving cross\-functional initiatives and influencing technical direction.

 **Strategist** 
 , shaping the long\-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an
 **Orchestrator**

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategist Mindset

* Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.
* Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.
* Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.
* Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI\-first design principles.


 Delivery \& Governance
   

  

 Builder Mindset
   

  

* Ship working AI solutions hands\-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.
* Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.
* Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.

 We are looking for a
 **Director \- Solution Architecture** 
 to lead the architecture and delivery of complex healthcare technology solutions for strategic enterprise clients across the United States. This is a senior, client\-facing leadership role focused on designing scalable solutions, driving complex implementations, translating business and regulatory requirements into technology capabilities, and ensuring successful enterprise adoption.
   

  

 The role will work closely with senior client stakeholders, product, engineering, implementation, operations, and commercial teams. You will own solution architecture across the full lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through implementation, go\-live, optimization, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare domain expertise with enterprise architecture, implementation leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex operational requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Enterprise Solution Architecture**
* Own solution architecture for a portfolio of strategic enterprise healthcare accounts from initial discovery through implementation and steady state
* Understand complex client workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, regulatory requirements, and technology environments
* Design scalable, secure, and configurable solutions that address multi\-site, multi\-state, and multi\-payer requirements
* Translate business and operational requirements into detailed solution architectures, workflows, integrations, configurations, and implementation plans
* Serve as the senior architectural counterpart to client technology, operations, finance, and business leadership
* Ensure solutions align with product capabilities, technical standards, security requirements, and long\-term scalability


**Solution Design \& Implementation**
* Lead architecture and solution design for complex enterprise implementations involving multiple locations, states, payers, workflows, and system integrations
* Define system configuration, integration dependencies, data flows, workflows, and implementation sequencing
* Work with implementation and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions are translated accurately into production\-ready solutions
* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and opportunities for standardization early in the lifecycle
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, configuration templates, solution frameworks, and implementation playbooks
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring implementation challenges and addressing them at the platform or architecture level


**Healthcare Revenue Cycle \& Domain Architecture**
* Apply strong knowledge of US healthcare revenue cycle processes to solution design, particularly outpatient and professional billing environments
* Translate requirements related to payer rules, claims processing, denials, eligibility, payment posting, reimbursement, and revenue cycle workflows into scalable technology solutions
* Understand healthcare transactions and standards including 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, EDI, ERA, and payer enrollment
* Incorporate requirements related to CMS\-1500, UB\-04, claim edits, NCCI logic, modifiers, therapy\-specific billing rules, claim scrubbing, remit reconciliation, and payment workflows
* Evaluate regulatory and payer changes and assess their implications for product architecture, integrations, and solution design
* Identify recurring operational or billing issues and work with product and engineering teams to address root causes through platform capabilities rather than manual intervention


**Enterprise Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting**
* Act as the senior solution architecture expert during enterprise sales pursuits, RFPs, discovery sessions, technical evaluations, and client presentations
* Lead solution discovery with prospective clients to understand business, operational, technical, and integration requirements
* Define what can realistically be delivered within existing product and technical capabilities and identify areas requiring customization or product enhancement
* Develop solution proposals, architecture approaches, implementation assumptions, integration strategies, and technical responses for enterprise opportunities
* Partner with sales and commercial teams to ensure technical commitments are accurate, achievable, and clearly documented
* Ensure requirements are captured effectively and handed over to implementation teams without unnecessary re\-discovery or ambiguity


**Product \& Technology Strategy**
* Translate enterprise customer requirements into actionable product and engineering requirements
* Partner with product leadership to influence roadmap priorities based on recurring customer needs, market requirements, and healthcare industry changes
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, configurability, automation, interoperability, and operational efficiency
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation and AI across healthcare workflows and revenue cycle processes
* Establish reusable architectural standards and patterns that enable faster implementation of future enterprise accounts
* Contribute to technical documentation, solution standards, architecture guidelines, and organizational knowledge repositories


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Work effectively across product, engineering, implementation, operations, sales, finance, compliance, and customer\-facing teams
* Lead through influence across cross\-functional teams without relying solely on direct reporting structures
* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to solution architects, implementation teams, and other technical stakeholders
* Establish clear ownership, decision\-making frameworks, escalation paths, and delivery standards for complex solutions
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Architecture Governance \& Performance**
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and solution governance processes
* Review proposed solutions for scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, and maintainability
* Monitor implementation and solution performance and identify opportunities for optimization
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring issues, evaluate solution effectiveness, and drive improvements
* Ensure enterprise solutions meet agreed business outcomes, technical standards, and implementation timelines


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Must\-Have**
* 12\-16 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, healthcare technology, revenue cycle technology, or related domains
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise healthcare solutions for large, multi\-site or multi\-state provider organizations
* Deep understanding of US healthcare revenue cycle processes, including professional billing, commercial insurance, Medicare/Medicaid, claims, denials, appeals, and payment workflows
* Strong working knowledge of healthcare interoperability and transaction standards, including EDI, 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, and ERA
* Experience leading complex implementations involving multiple systems, integrations, locations, states, and payer requirements
* Strong understanding of healthcare technology environments, including EMR/EHR, practice management, RCM, and healthcare SaaS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English with the ability to independently lead executive\-level business and technical discussions with US\-based clients
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical architectures and actionable implementation plans
* Data\-driven and structured approach to problem\-solving, architecture decisions, and solution optimization
* Comfortable working with teams and clients across US Eastern Time Zone working hours


**Strong Preference**

* Knowledge of therapy\-specific requirements such as the 8\-minute rule, therapy thresholds, KX modifiers, plan\-of\-care certification, and therapy modifiers
* Experience with multi\-state Medicaid or workers' compensation environments
* Experience working with healthcare SaaS, EMR/EHR, practice management, or RCM technology companies

**Nice to Have**

description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**

Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architecture Team partners with our users to realize their full potential through the adoption of prescriptive solutions that drive their growth and success.
   

  

 We work with founders, C\-level executives, finance leaders, product design and engineering teams at large global brands and platforms who are building financial services solutions with Stripe. We work closely with Account Executives, Professional Services, Customer Success Managers, Partners, Technical Account Managers Product, and Engineering teams to develop and execute on the account strategy for Stripe in market.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 You will be building trusted relationships with brand new founders to the C\-suite, and solving mission\-critical business challenges for our users. You will be building new business models and help expand existing ones with users of all shapes and sizes in the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support key technical engagements for Stripe in India
* Drive thought leadership and be a trusted advisor for key business and technical stakeholders including CIO, CTO, COO, CRO, CDO, Head of Product Engineering, and Head of Payments.
* Work to deeply understand the customer’s business objectives, and then design and apply Stripe’s solutions to their challenges. Develop and articulate the end to end customer transformation journey and create future roadmaps and architectures with deep 3rd party integrations in play.
* Lead strategy engagements with users to align to business priorities, design solutions and secure the technical win by performing in\-depth customer discovery, evangelizing the proposed solutions through executive briefings, readouts, presentations and solution demos.
* Bring understanding of the regional market to our Product and Engineering organizations by acting as the “Voice of the User” to bring insights, trends and opportunities to the leadership, product and engineering teams.

* Act as a crucial part of the sales team, providing technical insight and solutions to prospective and existing platform users. Guide and provide technical expertise on Stripe and its benefits.

* Manage pre\-sales projects, coordinating proof of concept development, and feasibility checks. Ensure all solutions proposed are viable, beneficial to our potential clients, and also accommodating to their customers.


 Who you are
   

  

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in a similar customer\-facing engineering role such as solution consultant, solutions architect, or sales engineer, for a global software enterprise.
* Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.
* Effective group\-facilitation skills and confidence in proposing and leading customer meetings to gain strategic footing and pursue opportunities.
* Thorough understanding of the software development lifecycle and API architecture.
* Outstanding spoken and written communication skills, presentation skills, and confidence in explaining complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Gather an in\-depth understanding of all of Stripe’s products and their applicability across diverse business models to beneficially cater to individual clients' and their customers' needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* \* Experience as a customer facing, domain expert in the payments space, presenting, and architecting solutions for platform customers.
+ Prior experience driving technical sales and supporting them and their customer’s unique requirements
+ Can read, write, and understand code in one to many programming languages
+ Experience with integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications.
+ Experience in systems design, building and deploying complex applications.
+ Passionate about learning and actively seeks out knowledge
+ Ability to work independently and confidently to develop a path forward with customers under ambiguous circumstances.
+ Strategic and creative thinker who can proactively identify challenges and maintain a positive approach when facing difficult obstacles.
+ Strong collaboration skills to work seamlessly with extended global teams to support our users.


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

title: D365 CE Technical Lead
description:
**Who Is Sa.global**
 sa.global, a global Microsoft partner, specializes in delivering AI\-powered, cloud\-based solutions tailored for service\-centric organizations such as architecture and engineering, legal, consulting, software services, accounting, and homebuilding. We help over 800,000 Microsoft Dynamics users across 80 countries to deliver operational excellence and financial performance for their organizations. An 11\-time winner of the coveted Microsoft Dynamics Partner of the Year Award, sa.global is also a part of Microsoft’s elite Inner Circle. Established in 1990, we are now a 1000\+ member strong global organization with a presence in 25 countries.
   

  

 For more information about sa.global, please click www.saglobal.com.
   

  

**Why choose sa.global**
 Open, flexible, vibrant, collaborative, and diverse – these are just some of the terms that our employees use to describe the culture at sa.global. We believe and encourage innovative and dynamic thinking. Our culture and values give us the extra edge to help us scale greater heights.
   

  

**Led by our Core Values:** 
 Agile, Capable, and Committed, which form an integral part of who we are, we constantly strive to provide an inclusive work environment. Our employees come from varied cultural and social backgrounds, and we strive each day to work towards making sa.global a great place to work.
   

  

**Values of sa.global**
* Contribute towards a working environment that represents “one sa.global” where everyone is seen as an equal, and equality and diversity is championed.
* Interact with a wide variety of colleagues, customers, and stakeholders at all levels with respect, courtesy, and professionalism.
* Come as you are, make work fun \& others successful, and foster an always learning mentality.


**About The Role**
 We offer a career with growth opportunities in a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive organization. We also have a strong and ethical working culture. If you'd to work with a team that is passionate about their work while also having a good sense of fun, you might have just found what you are looking for!
   

  

 sa.global is looking for a motivated and skilled D365 Customer Engagement (CE) Technical Consultant to join our dynamic consulting team in India! In this role, you will build robust CE solutions while leveraging cutting\-edge AI capabilities to drive intelligent business outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Customize and configure the D365 CE platform using various tools and technologies including but not limited to Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Copilot Studio.
* Design, develop, and deploy custom solutions, plugins, custom workflows, and integrations using the D365 CE SDK, C\#, JavaScript, and other relevant programming languages.
* Design and implement AI\-driven features within the Power Platform ecosystem, utilizing AI Builder, Microsoft Copilot integrations, and Azure Cognitive Services to enhance user productivity and automate processes.
* Extend the functionality of D365 CE by creating custom entities, attributes, relationships, and business rules to meet the specific business requirements of the organization.
* Implement integrations with other systems, both within the Microsoft ecosystem (e.g., SharePoint, Azure, Office 365\) and external third\-party applications using various integration methods and APIs.
* Integrate external AI models and Large Language Models (LLMs) via Azure OpenAI or custom RESTful APIs into D365 CE and Power Apps workflows.
* Assist in data migration activities including data extraction, transformation, and loading into the D365 CE platform.
* Conduct unit testing and debugging of customizations to ensure that they meet the specified requirements and are free of defects.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including technical design documents, code documentation, and deployment instructions.
* Ensure that all customizations and developments adhere to security and compliance standards, including data protection and access control.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical, AI\-enhanced solutions.
* Keep up to date with the latest features, updates, and best practices related to D365 CE development and emerging AI trends, ensuring that the organization is leveraging the platform effectively.


**The Requirements For This Role Include**
* Demonstrated 7\+ years of experience as a D365 CE Developer.
* Strong proficiency in C\#, JavaScript, HTML, and web services development.
* Familiar with D365 CE customization and configuration using Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
* Practical knowledge of integrating AI capabilities within Dynamics 365, including experience with AI Builder, Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents), or Azure AI.
* Knowledge of D365 CE SDK and development tools such as Visual Studio and Azure DevOps.
* Experience with integration tools and methods, RESTful APIs, and data migration.
* Fundamental understanding of prompt engineering and how to apply AI to solve CRM\-specific business challenges.
* Understanding software development best practices, including version control and code review processes.
* Graduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a D365 CE Developer or similar role with a focus on customizing and extending the D365 CE platform.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate) are highly desirable. Additional AI\-related certifications (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals) are a strong plus.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a global team.
* Possess strong relationship\-building expertise with a wide and varied audience, internally and externally.

title: Senior Partner Solutions Architect
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Atlassian is looking for a
 **Senior** 
**Partner Solutions Architect** 
 , reporting to the International Head of Partner Solutions.
   

  

 This is a remote position. To help our teams work together effectively, this role
 **requires you to be located** 
 in
 **India.**
 At Atlassian, our mission is to empower customers to thrive in the digital economy by delivering innovative, enterprise\-grade solutions. As a leader in enterprise platform and AI adoption, Atlassian is committed to enabling organizations to unlock the full potential of our Cloud platform by identifying and driving high\-impact use cases that leverage our robust platform capabilities and cutting\-edge AI technologies to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you will lead the development and implementation of tailored solutions that accelerate enterprise transformation with end customers, working closely with partners in the region to understand their customers' unique needs, design scalable architectures, and champion the adoption of AI\-driven workflows and automation. Your expertise will guide partners and customers through every stage of their journey, from discovery and assessment to successful delivery of complex transformation projects, ensuring they realize measurable value from Atlassian’s platform and AI investments.
   

  

**Your future team**
 Our Partner Solutions team brings together experts with deep experience in Cloud Acceleration \& Upgrades, Solution Design, and Architecture. With a strong focus on building partner Enterprise cloud capabilities, we help drive successful cloud transformations by providing technical expertise, strategic guidance, and best\-in\-class solutions to support seamless migrations and enterprise adoption.
   

  

 This is a
 **unique opportunity** 
 to help shape
 **the future of Atlassian’s Partner ecosystem** 
 . If you are passionate about technology, innovation, strategy, and driving business impact, this could be the perfect role for you.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive digital transformation and AI initiatives, leveraging your expertise in product, consulting, and sales. You’ll also develop deep knowledge of the Atlassian platform, becoming a subject matter expert to support customer success.

* Lead and collaborate across Atlassian, to build and deliver a coordinated capability model.

 At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
   

  

 This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
   

  

**Your background**
* Experienced in product, consulting, and sales for digital transformation across different markets.
* Strong business acumen with consultative selling skills.
* Proven success in building effective internal and external partnerships.
* In\-depth understanding of SaaS platform benefits and underlying technologies.
* Broad knowledge of cloud and AI technologies, with the ability to dive deep when needed.
* Collaborative experience working with partners/GSIs.

**Benefits \& Perks**
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
 **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
   

  

 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Principal Systems Engr
description:
**About Us**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission\-focused execution.
   

  

 Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
   

  

 Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
   

  

 Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
   

  

**Electronic Solutions**
 Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on\-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.
   

  

 As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
   

  

**Electronic Solutions** 
 develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30\-plus years in service to radiation\-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.
   

  

**Principal Systems Engineer**
 Technically Lead, develop, and motivate engineering teams responsible for the System design and development of Business Jet programs. You will be responsible for defining, executing the technical content by working with high performing System engineers. You will participate in all phases of Program development and drive high impact growth projects.
   

  

 Develop, mentor and inspire engineers who work to develop innovative products and technologies. Influence \& challenge engineer teams to effectively solve complex engineering problems.
   

  

 Build and guide highly talented engineering teams to deliver exceptional solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Skills:**
 This role will be primarily responsible for
   

  

* Execution Excellence
+ Technical Lead for a project, including project’s overall technical solution, system level performance, configuration management, quality, and certification
+ Managing System requirements, controlling scope, and executing baseline change management
+ Leading critical stage gates and objectives of programs viz., Technical Concept Review (TCR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDRs), Critical Design Reviews (CDRs), Phase gate exits, SOI/SR (Supplier Review) Audits and Customer \& Cert authority reviews as required.
+ Define and drive the ARP4754A/B practices across the programs by demonstrating strong adherence and compliance with the same
+ Responsible to ensure Programs are compliance to TSO standards (TSO C\-165a/b, C\-195b) for the applicable products and meet System/Software Certification Requirements
+ Participates in Systems and Software architecture, Requirement and Design reviews.
+ Drive strong System/Software Architectures and reduce the integration cost of inserting the products into program
+ Strategically own and drive key initiatives viz., System Engineering Improvements (content development plans, Integrated Verification Test Plans (IVTP), Use Cases, System Test Integration Checkouts) and influence stakeholders on early adaption and incremental outcomes.
+ Drive efficiencies across the COEs and drive productivity
+ Strategically own and drive key initiatives viz., Systems Test Integration Testing, Model based development and influence stakeholders on early adaption and incremental outcomes.
+ Driving strong Basis of Estimates (BOE) across each of the Quotation estimates of responsible program for the content by working through PEs, Systems Leads, functional leads and technical managers as required.
+ Provides hands\-on engineering support, mentor and groom engineers on the programs and their technical career path

* Technology and Business
+ Responsible for System technical solution development (Design \& interface definition). Demonstrate thought leadership with focus on System architecture with increased reusability and drive reduction in program cost.
+ Establishes strong working relationships with key stakeholders ( Product Managers, Chiefs, Human Factors ) to drive growth through NPI’s (New Product Introduction).
+ Engages in software architecture, design and requirement reviews as a key input provider, first level approver.
+ Drive robust plan and pipeline of rapid prototypes for the near\-term risk avoidance to the program and medium\-term features which bring revenue potential through POC (Proof of Concept), POVs (Point of View) / Agile model.

* Strategic Impact
+ Works with Engineering Managers to develop capability in Systems expertise
+ Collaborate effectively as required on High Growth Regions pursuits, participate in industry/customer visits, share knowledge gained through conference participation etc.
+ Imbibes and role model Honeywell Aerospace behaviors and values and act as change agent.
+ Supporting Strategic Plan revenue targets through competitive intelligence and product line software architecture frameworks
+ Driving technology initiatives and feature insertion per M\&PM (Marketing \& Product Management) Displays programs roadmap \& strategies


**Qualifications**
**Skill Requirement**
* B.E/B. Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Electric/Electronics/Computers/Aerospace Engineering
* Minimum 20\+ years of experience working in various application areas supporting avionics functions
* Experience working in Systems Architecture, Requirements, Design, software development and reviews. Working experience and Knowledge of Displays Product lines is preferred
* Have experience in performing Systems Engineering leadership roles on the programs with accountability.
* Expertise working with Aerospace standards, ARP4754A/B and DO178B/C
* Possess good understanding of business objectives and more importantly the ability to interact with our customers (internal and external).
* Able to identify and manage risks and opportunities with demonstrated capability to manage multiple projects
* Must have excellent communication, collaboration and networking skills
* Passion to explore opportunities and solutions


 Honeywell Aerospace never requests or accepts money from candidates at any stage of the hiring process. Any demand for payment in exchange for employment opportunities is fraudulent and should be reported immediately to local law enforcement authorities

title: Principal Software Architect-AI
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 The Unified Communication team at Motorola Solutions is seeking an accomplished and visionary Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead our Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and Strategic Project initiatives. This pivotal role involves leading a high\-performing engineering team focused on designing, developing, and deploying cutting\-edge AI\-driven solutions that enhance our unified communication products and services. The ideal candidate possesses a deep technical background in software engineering, a proven track record of managing and mentoring technical teams, and extensive experience in bringing AI/ML models from research, prototypes to production\-ready enterprise systems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Leadership and Management
   

  

* Lead the software engineers, machine learning engineers, and data scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Define team priorities, allocate resources, manage project timelines, and ensure high\-quality, on\-time delivery of AI/ML\-powered features.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support the career development of team members.
* Collaborate with product management and cross\-functional teams to translate business needs and product requirements into technical specifications and a clear AI/ML roadmap.


**Technical Strategy and Execution**
* Define the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for integrating AI and ML capabilities across the Unified Communication product portfolio (e.g., natural language processing for translation, transcription and summarization, predictive analytics, intelligent routing, conversational AI).
* Oversee the entire AI/ML lifecycle, from data collection and model training to MLOps, deployment, monitoring, and performance tuning in production environments.
* Ensure the engineering team adheres to best practices in software development, including code review, unit testing, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and secure coding standards.
* Drive the selection and implementation of appropriate technologies, frameworks, and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) to support scalable and robust AI infrastructure.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with AI Engineering organization, Research \& Developments teams to identify emerging AI technologies, frameworks, platforms and assess their potential for application within the Unified Communications product line.
* Work with Data Governance and Legal teams to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and ethical AI principles
* Communicate complex technical concepts and project status effectively to executive leadership and non\-technical stakeholders.


 Basic RequirementsBachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
   

  

* 
+ Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or management role directly overseeing AI/ML or data\-intensive engineering teams.
+ Deep practical experience with the full lifecycle of building, deploying, and maintaining production\-grade machine learning models (MLOps).
+ Strong programming skills in languages such as Python and Java/C\+\+, and familiarity with common ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn).
+ Proven experience designing and implementing scalable cloud\-native architectures for AI applications on major platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP).


**Preferred Requirements**
* Experience in Crafting precise, effective prompts to guide AI models for specific outputs (e.g., text, code, images) and iterative refinement.
* Extensive experience in building custom, reusable, proactive, "context\-aware" AI assistants that understand specific, recurring contexts like situational factors and technical states that consistently shape how an end user interacts with an application.
* Extensive experience in Utilizing AI to structure, clean, and analyze unstructured data for actionable insights and visualization.
* Experience in developing Agentic AI solutions for Real Time Mission Critical Audio, Video and Data Communications or closely related enterprise software industry.
* Demonstrated ability to drive technical innovation and influence organizational strategy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 Under 10%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 None
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
